core_obligations: Statement (lines 712-715): the complement of K_0 is not computably enumerable.
Argument (proof lines 717-721): K_0 is c.e. but not computable (thm:K-0); were its complement c.e., thm:ce-comp would make K_0 computable - contradiction.
proof_roadmap: Recall K_0's c.e.-but-not-computable status from thm:K-0.
Suppose the complement c.e. and apply the computability characterisation.
Contradiction with K_0's non-computability closes the corollary.
